title: A history version saved before the release shows one representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Use a work order for that customer, still open and not invoiced, that had sales rep B as its one Sales Representative before the release was installed, with a version saved to its history with sales rep B before the release.
  • With the release installed, open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order's history.
  2. Open the version saved before the release.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The history opens.

Step 2:

  • That version shows one "Sales Representative" field reading sales rep B as plain text.
  • It is not split.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names. On the read-only card only the Sales Representative fields read as in S1-R2 and S2-R5; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's read-only labels.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, frontend risks: “Old WO history snapshots lack `sales_rep_split`; treated as not split. Old history entries lack C4 fields; rendered as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
